evidence: grocery/out/flagged-2026-09-23.json multibuy_unpriced (72 rows, 71 Family Fare): hand-soap @ Family Fare 'Dove Hand Wash, Antibacterial 12 Fl Oz' and 'Dove Hand Wash, Shea Butter & Warm Vanilla 12 Fl Oz', 'Buy 1 get 1 40% off', regular $5.99, 12 oz: reason 'priced but OUT-OF-BAND ($0.3993 outside 0.01216-0.304) - likely a bad multibuy size/regular parse'
arithmetic reproduces: $5.99 x 1.6 / 24 oz = $0.3993/oz, so the parse is right and the price is real; the band ceiling $0.304/oz refuses a real Dove sale
shampoo @ Family Fare 'Dove Shampoo, Intensive Repair 12 Fl Oz' and 'Daily Moisture 12 Fl Oz', regular $8.99, 12 oz: $8.99 x 1.6 / 24 = $0.5993/oz against a band ceiling of $0.525: the same shape
the 4 lines are 2 keys (MULTIBUY|Family Fare|hand-soap, MULTIBUY|Family Fare|shampoo): check-ad-cycles.ps1:3298 adds one line per ROW but one key per commodity id
the alert body says 'these still published; verify they are real' (check-ad-cycles.ps1:3529), which is false for a MULTIBUY line: a multibuy_unpriced row is NOT on the board

comparison-2026-09-23: Family Fare's hand-soap cell is $0.0998/oz (Top Care 50 Fl Oz) and its shampoo cell $0.0993/oz (Alberto VO5 15 Fl Oz); the Dove sales at $0.3993 and $0.5993 are 4x and 6x those, so no cell would move if they were admitted

items.root_cause: commodity includes are enumerated brand and word forms, so a name that says the same thing in another word order ('Liquid Laundry') or another name for the product ('Pepper Sauce') cannot match; the semantic sweep is the detector that sees it, and the only repair is a rule edit

root_fix.what: widen laundry-detergent to 'liquid laundry' and hot-sauce to a cayenne or Louisiana 'pepper sauce' form (not a bare 'pepper sauce', which also names sweet chili and stir-fry sauces)
root_fix.exact_change: money lane: laundry-detergent.include += '\bliquid\s+laundry\b'; hot-sauce.include += a pepper-sauce form bounded to cayenne / red devil / louisiana

prevention.what: the emitting check: a finding leaves the sweep as a bare alert line, with no diagnosis and no candidate, so every return of this type costs a lane the same derivation (explain-coverage-gap, then read the include) before the rule edit; three prior closes each repaired only the names they were handed
prevention.exact_change: money lane: the sweep hands each coverage finding to explain-coverage-gap.ps1's verdict (NO-INCLUDE / EXCLUDED / CLAIMED / MATCHES) and records the unmatched distinguishing phrase beside it in semantic-findings.json, so the alert names the fix; the rule edits themselves stay in grocery/commodities.json
